caption: The drawing shows a single cast iron trivet with an ornate, openwork design. The trivet is triangular with rounded edges and features intricate scrollwork and a central star motif. It is dark brown with lighter highlights that suggest metallic reflections and wear. Three short legs support the trivet, raising it off the surface. There is an elongated oval handle on one end, and the object casts a slight, diffuse shadow on the plain off-white background. Handwritten text appears near the lower right of the drawing, with the name "Amos C. Brixton" and some numbers, as well as “SERIES C Exam #21” at the bottom.
title: Flat Iron Stand
